From the price list

Prices as on the price list at the entrance, photographed in the restaurant’s Google listing, in euro including VAT and service. Chicken and meat dishes are portions with potatoes or chips. What is cooking changes with the day; a board by the door lists the week, from pastitsio, afelia and stifado to moussaka, kalamari and fish. A set of small salad or juice, chicken, potatoes, stuffed vegetables and Cyprus coffee is 12 euro.

From the kitchen

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

Modest outside, a home inside

Acropolis Restaurant sits on Anthipolochagou Georgiou Savva street in Geroskipou. The white sign reads Estiatorio Akropolis Psistaria, homemade food, take away, and that is the whole promise: a small family place with blue checked tablecloths, run by a husband and wife. Guests on Google write that the two have cooked here for 30 years, start early every morning, explain every dish at the counter and put together a tasting selection for newcomers. The words that come up most often are Cypriot cuisine, friendly owners and homemade food; lemon chicken, lamb and okra get named again and again.

Open Monday to Saturday from six in the morning until five in the afternoon, Sunday closed. Eat in, take away or delivery.

What guests say

Two of 180 Google reviews, 4.9 stars on average.

“A hidden gem and a beautiful restaurant you must try if in Paphos. The owners were so kind and helpful. They showed me the food on offer and we picked a variety of different plates to share. The food is fresh and home cooked. An authentic place if you want a true Cypriot experience. Here's a tip: go for the slow cooked lamb, it's incredible. Thank you for the great food and hospitality.”
Daniel Hart · Google review
“The restaurant looks very modest from the outside, but from the very first moment we were warmly welcomed by the elderly couple who run the place. The host suggested a tasting menu specially composed for us, explaining in detail what each dish was made of and how it was prepared. Everything was fresh, homemade, and absolutely delicious. We truly felt like we were at home. The atmosphere, food, and service all deserve six stars.”
Stanisław Marciniak · Google review
